checks.result: Full local formatting, lint, strict types, 20 unit tests (10 new), 8 harness regressions and production builds passed.

QA exercised TypeScript entrypoint via Node tsx loader: occupied port exits1 with EADDRINUSE; invalid service/auth config names fields without credentials; free-port liveness200 and SIGTERM shutdown. Architecture independently repeated built-entrypoint failure probes.
Local live PostgreSQL/Redis/S3 unavailable. No fresh local identity/readiness claim; PR CI retains real services and all existing tests. This scoped change does not alter authentication logic.

findings.summary: Diagnostic getter could throw during error handling and escape raw logging boundary.
findings.resolution: Formatter catches property-inspection failures; message/code getters cannot escape; independent review and regressions pass.

findings.summary: Failure cleanup could wait forever and suppress nonzero exit.
findings.resolution: Cleanup operations have a3s deadline each; timers released and hanging/failed cleanup tests pass. Nested paths can consume successive deadlines.

limitations: The user's Mac is not accessible; the original local failure is not yet identified. Docker port conflicts were observed in user-supplied logs; demo tsx startup succeeds in the executor.
